name: DHL Supply Chain - IDS Fulfillment DC - Salt Lake City UT

fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. The building's west dock face fronts directly onto the public street (4650 West) — trucks back off the road into the docks. Street View (2021-05 and 2025-07) shows no barrier arm, no sliding gate, no perimeter fence. South-end driveway also open.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at any entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate, so no remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors run along the building's west face directly on the street; ~32 doors estimated from Street View, band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Only a handful of trailers parked at the docks; no dedicated drop yard. Trailers back directly off the public road.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Trucks back off the street directly into docks; no internal queueing depth.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~220,000 sq ft temperature-controlled building (per IDS site); parcel ~13 acres.
